title: Fire-resistance-rated walls.
officialText: Penetrations into or through fire walls, fire barriers, smoke barrier walls, and fire partitions shall comply with Sections 713.3.1 through 713.3.3. Penetrations in smoke barrier walls shall also comply with Section 713.5.
